look_here_first: Look at the deep acorn cup that almost encloses the nut; then examine rounded leaf lobes and pale hairy undersides.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Swamp chestnut oak has a shallow acorn cup and toothed leaves; bur oak has a fringed cup rim.
